diagnosticDefinitions.opening: first one or two whitespace-delimited tokens before punctuation; equal openings are candidates, not automatic issues
diagnosticDefinitions.openingWindow: same exact opening appearing within 7 calendar days across any slots
diagnosticDefinitions.nearDuplicateWindow: validator candidate pair selected on the same day or with a difference of at most 2 day indexes (within 3 calendar dates)
diagnosticDefinitions.categoryCluster: highest per-category frequency in every 7-day / 21-question window
diagnosticDefinitions.toneCandidate: at least two prompts containing one or more conservative Korean strain/emotion cue substrings; requires human review
diagnosticDefinitions.categoryUniqueness: soft policy preference that yielded three different categories per day in these runs
diagnosticDefinitions.semanticReview: No AI semantic classifier; evidence is generated from deterministic string/category diagnostics and then read manually.
